[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/INFANT-CHILD-CARE/infant-childcare-subsidies#main-content) # Infant and Childcare Subsidies - SupportGoWhere Infant and Childcare Subsidies Share link Provides tiered subsidies to help cover infant care and childcare fees for Singapore Citizen children from different income backgrounds. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Working applicants: Basic Subsidy of $600 for infant care and $300 for childcare - Non-working applicants: Basic Subsidy of $150 for infant care and childcare - Additional Subsidy for working applicants Expand all sections About this support **Working applicants (mother or single father who works at least 56 hours per month)** - Basic Subsidy of $600 for infant care and $300 for childcare - Additional Subsidy of up to $710 for infant care and up to $467 for childcare **Non-working applicants** - Basic Subsidy of $150 for infant care and childcare - Eligible applicants who are not working or who are non-parent caregivers can apply for Special Approval to receive the higher Basic Subsidy and Additional Subsidy that working applicants receive Who is this for? | Types of subsidies | Eligibility criteria | | For all subsidies | - Child must be a Singapore Citizen

- Enrolled in an infant care or childcare centre licensed by ECDA | | Additional Subsidy | - Working applicants (mother or single father who works at least 56 hours per month)

- Monthly household income of up to $12,000, or monthly household income per capita of up to $3,000 for larger families with 5 or more family members in the same household

- From 1 January 2027, monthly household income thresholds will be raised to $15,000, or $3,400 per capita | | Special Approval | - Main subsidy applicants who are not working due to the following reasons:

- Looking for a job

- Studying, training, or on course for at least 56 hours a month

- Pregnancy

- Medically unfit for work due to hospitalisation, long-term illness and/or permanent disability

- Taking care of a special needs child

- Taking care of a sick family member who requires a full-time caregiver

- Caring full-time for a younger child aged 24 months and below who is not enrolled in a preschool

- Incarcerated

- Non-parent caregivers who are caring for the child such as grandparents, legal guardian, foster parents, and head of a children’s home
- Families who are tenants of a rental flat under the HDB’s Public Rental Scheme or are beneficiaries of ComCare Short-To-Medium-Term Assistance (SMTA) or Long-Term-Assistance (LTA) will automatically qualify for maximum preschool subsidies upon application for Special Approval | How to apply? Refer to Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) [website](https://www.ecda.gov.sg/parents/preschool-subsidies/how-to-apply-or-make-changes-to-subsidies) to apply or make changes to subsidies Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.ecda.gov.sg/parents/preschool-subsidies/how-to-apply-or-make-changes-to-subsidies) * * * ECDA hotline: [6735 9213](tel:67359213) * * * [Submit an enquiry](mailto:Contact@ecda.gov.sg) * * * [ECDA office](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=229469) [51 Cuppage Road,](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=229469) [#08-01,](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=229469) [Singapore 229469](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=229469) Scheme last updated 19 May 2026 Try our AI search
